name: bugsniffer
description: Free Sniff Score for your deployed web app: score, findings and a fix prompt your agent can act on.
long_description: Bugsniffer is AI-run QA for vibe-coded apps. This server loads your public homepage once, like a visitor would, and returns a score out of 100, a verdict, structured findings (console errors, failed requests, broken links, speed, mobile layout, accessibility, SEO) and a fix prompt. Fix, redeploy, re-sniff. Free keys get 10 sniffs a day. Paid Smoke and Deep runs test every page, form, login and checkout.
